infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: OpenKumi connects to the computer on your network that runs your bots.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: OpenKumi listens while you dictate a message to a bot, and while you are on a call with one. Dictation is written down on this iPhone and never leaves it as sound; on a call, your voice goes to the speech model that answers you.

plugins.cameraPermission: OpenKumi uses the camera to scan the pairing code shown on your computer, and to take photos you send to your bots.
